terms.name: Basket
terms.definition: The cart's aggregate. An order carries its basket's id and is placed from it exactly once.

terms.name: Bus
terms.definition: NATS JetStream when configured, in process otherwise. One stream per service, named for its subjects.

terms.name: Cancelled
terms.definition: The order will not be fulfilled: the customer asked, or the payment was declined. Terminal.

terms.name: Confirmed
terms.definition: The payment is authorised; the order may be fulfilled.

terms.name: Decline
terms.definition: Ledger's refusal to hold an order's total, with a reason from a closed set. Final for the checkout: it cancels a placed order, never retried.

terms.name: Line
terms.definition: One SKU of the order, how many, and the unit price it was added to the basket at. Copied, never repriced.

terms.name: Money
terms.definition: An amount in the minor unit of a currency.

terms.name: Order
terms.definition: What a basket became at checkout: the lines and the total the customer agreed to, under one lock. The aggregate root.

terms.name: Outbox
terms.definition: The table an event waits in, written in the transaction that produced it, until the relay puts it on the bus.

terms.name: Payments
terms.definition: The ledger that authorises an order's total. A port here; nothing provides it yet.

terms.name: Placed
terms.definition: The order exists and is waiting for its payment to be authorised. Where every order starts.

terms.name: Relay
terms.definition: The loop that moves outbox rows to the bus and marks them published.
